text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SLO ALERT — streaming.generate p99 > 2400ms (p95 ~540ms) in us-west1 for the last 5m. Affected routes: /v1/stream, /v1/chat-stream. Paging @oncall-rotation. Incident ID: INC-3111112222
alice: ACK — grabbing Grafana + traces, joining bridge
ben: i'm on dashboards: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/streams/streaming-latency (refreshing)
devon: quick check: node-rt-14 GPU util spiked to 92%  — multiple long token gen spikes
car­men: any 5xxs? customer-facing errors?
oncall-rotation: errors are low but downstream client timeouts rising on long streams
alice: pulling tail logs around 3111112000..3111112220, looks like repeated KV cache misses on model x-bf16-v2
devon: starting diagnostic steps: 1) isolate node-rt-14, 2) evict/kvcache on node, 3) traffic-shift to model-compact-1 for long streams
oncall-rotation: customer impact: a handful of premium streams experiencing >2s p99. Noting for paging and CS outreach if persists
ben: initiating gradual traffic shift 10% -> model-compact-1 for /v1/stream long-session policy (via rollout API)
alice: also kicking a restart of redwood-runtime on node-rt-14 (evict KV in process)
devon: rollout command: `POST /control/route-shift {"route":"/v1/stream","percent":10,"model":"model-compact-1"}` — applying now
incident-bot: route-shift executed, policy id shift-3111-01, rollout=10%
ben: watching p99 window: 2m after shift p99 dropped from 2400ms -> 1100ms
carmen: still seeing a few tail stalls — probably sessions pinned to node-rt-14 before shift
alice: node-rt-14 restart complete, KV hit-rate recovering: 32% -> 91% over 60s
devon: confirming logs: kvcache miss rate down; token-gen median back to ~380ms
oncall-rotation: excellent. increase shift to 30% while we monitor
ben: increased shift to 30%, p99 trending ~620ms now; long tails mostly mitigated
carmen: recommend follow-up: schedule post-incident trace to root cause kvcache thrash on node-rt-14, and add auto-eviction trigger if kv hit <40% for 2m
alice: filing INC-3111112222 in ops tracker, assigning to devon for RCA and to product for customer comms
ben: leaving bridge, will update thread if regresses :thumbsup:
devon: will run a deeper kernel and memory check on node-rt-14, and prepare runbook update
incident-bot: Incident mitigated — SLOs within thresholds; marking as "mitigated". Suggested next steps: RCA, runbook update, customer check-ins. :white_check_mark:
